hera (research): FYI onboarding eval for rerank-medium-ptq shows ndcg@10 +1.0% but mrr@1 -1.9% vs fp16 on holdout-gamma.
omar (ml): same harness/seed?
hera (research): yes: `eval/run --model rerank-medium-ptq --set holdout-gamma --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@1 --seed 101`
ci-bot: job 43021 completed  results: https://ci.redwood.ai/43021
ryan (infra): build used symmetric PTQ with the latest int8 runtime. we added a tiny output clamp two commits ago.
zoe (prod): did we change candidate merging or passage trimming in last deploy?
hera (research): we compared two input protocols: "atomic" (each passage separate) and "merged-top3" (concat top3). flips mostly in merged-top3. flip-rate top1 merged=5.2%, atomic=1.3%.
omar (ml): likely quant-induced compression of logits combined with extra separator tokens from merging. ndcg can go up if more relevant docs aggregate higher ranks while mrr punishes top1 swaps.
ryan (infra): i'll diff the clamp commit and run a kernel revert test in staging.
hera (research): sample trace example:
```
# q: how to rotate keys
fp16: A=4.22 (rank1), B=3.91 (rank2)
int8: A=4.03, B=4.06 -> flip
# gap 0.31 -> -0.03
```
omar (ml): quick ablation plan: 1) deterministic ordering (no shuffle) 2) tokenization parity check on merged separators 3) logit rescale sweep [0.99..1.04] 4) flip-rate metric added to CI.
hera (research): ran 3) briefly: multiplier 1.02 recovers ~+1.6% mrr and keeps ndcg +0.8%. flip-rate drops by ~60% on merged set.
ryan (infra): queued kernel-revert job in staging (43022). if kernel is culprit we revert; otherwise we can hotpatch per-model logit multiplier.
zoe (prod): if multiplier is safe across cohorts we can gate rollout on it and update the ops runbook with hotpatch steps and monitoring on flip-rate and top1 delta. please sync tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
